title: mold_v1 application spec
description: A complete description of one mold_v1 application, as one file. Check it with python3 .claude/scripts/factory.py spec check <file>; mint it with python3 .claude/scripts/mint.py new <app_id> --spec <file>. Generated by .claude/scripts/app_spec.py generate: never edit by hand.
markdownDescription:
A complete description of one **mold_v1** application (a chat workspace with specialist subagents and a data room).

- Check: `python3 .claude/scripts/factory.py spec check <file>`
- Mint: `python3 .claude/scripts/mint.py new <app_id> --spec <file>`

_Generated by `.claude/scripts/app_spec.py generate`; never edit by hand._

app_id.description: The application's id: lower-case letters, digits and underscores (its folder under state/application/).
app_id.markdownDescription: The application's id, e.g. `acme_desk`: lower-case letters, digits and underscores. Its state lives in `state/application/<app_id>/`.

mold_id.description: The mold this app is made from: mold_v1.
mold_id.markdownDescription: The mold this app is made from. This schema is **mold_v1**'s.

kind.description: tool (default): people open the app itself. embedded: the app runs inside another product, which needs a developer surface and the platform audit trail.
kind.markdownDescription:
- `tool` (default): people open the app itself.
- `embedded`: the app runs **inside another product**; it then needs `developer_surface` and `audit.platform: true`.

product.title: The product people see
product.description: The brand: name, colour and logo are required (an app never ships under the mold's default name), tagline and domain optional.
product.markdownDescription: The brand people see. **name, colour and logo are required**: every new app is branded before its first deploy, never shipped under the mold's default name. `branding.py` derives the rest (palette, icon, sign-in mark) from these three.

name.markdownDescription: The product's name, e.g. `Acme Desk`. A brief's `Product name:` line; names the product in `state/products.json` (created when new).

colour.markdownDescription: The brand colour, `#RRGGBB` (e.g. `#1F6F5C`). The palette, icon and legible foreground are derived from it.

logo.markdownDescription: The logo file, a path from the factory's root: `brands/<name>/logo.svg` (or .png). `factory.py spec check` says when it is not on this machine.

domain.description: The app's own web address (optional; a server of its own needs one).
domain.markdownDescription: The app's own web address, e.g. `app.example.com`. Optional on Vercel; **required on a server of its own**.

deploy.title: Where it runs
deploy.description: Where the app runs: vercel, vm (a database check on this machine only) or vm_remote (a server of its own; needs server and product.domain).
deploy.markdownDescription:
- `vercel`: the factory's Vercel team.
- `vm`: verifies a database on this machine only (serves nothing).
- `vm_remote`: a server of its own over SSH; needs `server` and `product.domain`.

audit.title: Audit trails (mold_v0-197)
audit.description: Two audit trails, each on or off on its own (both default false). Separate from usage metering, which always stays on. mold_v0 writes it to the app's profile.audit (mold_v0-197, src/audit-trail.ts; entries kept 400 days unless profile.audit.retention_days says otherwise).
audit.markdownDescription:
Two audit trails, **each on or off on its own** (both default `false`).

- `data`: every read, change, reveal and export of a workspace's records, visible to that workspace's admins.
- `platform`: every API and MCP request and every sign-in, with the key, the actor and the scope, plus staff actions on accounts.

Separate from **usage metering**, which always stays on. An `embedded` app needs `platform: true`.

_mold_v0 writes it to the app's `profile.audit` (mold_v0-197, `src/audit-trail.ts`); entries are kept 400 days unless `profile.audit.retention_days` says otherwise._

data.title: Data audit trail
data.description: Every read, change, reveal and export of a workspace's records, visible to that workspace's admins.
data.markdownDescription: **Data audit trail**: every read, change, reveal and export of a workspace's records, shown to that workspace's admins. Default `false`.

platform.title: Platform audit trail
platform.description: Every API/MCP request and sign-in, with key, actor and scope, plus staff actions on accounts. Required (true) for kind embedded.
platform.markdownDescription: **Platform audit trail**: every API and MCP request and every sign-in, with the key, the actor and the scope, plus platform staff's actions on accounts. Default `false`; **must be `true` when `kind` is `embedded`**.

developer_surface.title: Developer surface (mold_v0-193)
developer_surface.description: What a host application's developers build against when this app is embedded in it: the events it emits to webhooks, the SDK languages generated, the client sessions the host's backend mints, and optional inbound webhook receivers. mold_v0 builds it (the REST API at /v1, /openapi.json, keys, client sessions, webhooks out and in, the SDKs): mint new --spec writes it into the app's first inline pack as pack.json developer_surface. mold_v1: recorded with the spec only. Required when kind is embedded.
developer_surface.markdownDescription:
What a **host application's developers** build against when this app is embedded in their product.

- `events`: what the app sends to the host's webhooks (mold_v0: `record.created`, `record.updated`, `record.state_changed`, `record.deleted`, `run.finished`, `clock.overdue`; a record event may name `areas`).
- `sdk_languages`: the SDKs generated (mold_v0: `typescript`, `python`).
- `client_sessions`: short-lived sessions the host's own backend mints for its signed-in users.
- `webhooks_in` (optional): receivers that write a signed payload into a workspace record area.
- `api_version` (optional): the dated version.

**mold_v0** implements it (mold_v0-193): `mint.py new --spec` writes it into the app's first inline pack. Required when `kind` is `embedded`.

events.markdownDescription: Each event the embedded app emits (to the host page, and to the host's webhook): `name` like `record.created`, `description` in one sentence, and optionally `payload`, a JSON Schema of its data.

name.markdownDescription: The event's name: dotted lower case, e.g. record.created, run.finished.

description.markdownDescription: What the event means, in one sentence.

payload.description: Optional: a JSON Schema of the event's data (draft 2020-12).
payload.markdownDescription: Optional: a JSON Schema of the event's data (draft 2020-12).

sdk_languages.markdownDescription: The languages the client SDK ships in, e.g. `["typescript", "python"]`.

client_sessions.title: Client sessions
client_sessions.description: Short-lived sessions the host application's backend mints for its own signed-in users, so they use the embedded app without a second sign-in.
client_sessions.markdownDescription: Short-lived sessions the **host's backend** mints for its own signed-in users (no second sign-in). `ttl_seconds`: how long one lasts; `allowed_origins`: the host pages (https) that may embed the app; `scopes`: what a session may do.

ttl_seconds.description: How long one session lasts, in seconds (60 to 86400).
ttl_seconds.markdownDescription: How long one session lasts, in seconds (60 to 86400).

allowed_origins.description: The host pages allowed to embed the app: https origins like https://app.example.com.
allowed_origins.markdownDescription: The host pages allowed to embed the app: https origins like https://app.example.com.

scopes.description: What a client session may do, e.g. read, write, run. Absent: read and write.
scopes.markdownDescription: What a client session may do, e.g. read, write, run. Absent: read and write.

webhooks_in.description: Optional: receivers that write a verified (Standard Webhooks) payload into one of the app's workspace record areas.

items.markdownDescription: A JSON Pointer to a list: each item is one record.
